purpose: Separate dependence on motor exploration from a common-panel versus training-continuation map effect at identical frozen network checkpoints.

maps.common: The exact existing disjoint 32-note relative-time/cue-gain panel, translated to each checkpoint time.
maps.continuation: The seed's actual next 32 training-map note times and gains at checkpoints 24 and 96. At 384, notes 385-416 are generated by continuing the original map-extension RNG after note 384, with the same interval/gain choice lists and draw order. No continuation-map note is used to alter the frozen checkpoint.

exploration.off: Freeze weights and suppress exploration; preserve the checkpoint RNG state, readout and neural state.
exploration.on: Freeze weights but allow the original 0.002 per-tick cue-gated motor exploration. Use three predeclared streams: repeat 0 preserves the checkpoint RNG state; repeats 1 and 2 replace only the probe clone's exploration RNG with Random(seed_from_SHA256). The seed is the unsigned integer represented by the first 8 bytes of SHA-256 of UTF-8 text 'synthetic_frozen_exploration_map_factorial_v1|seed|checkpoint|repeat'. The off branch is deterministic and runs once per map.

fixed_state: For each seed, replay the original 384-outcome on-condition training session exactly; compare every checkpoint event with its saved ledger before cloning. Each branch begins from the same full checkpoint; only probe map and exploration stream/switch differ. All branches disable plasticity and never feed results back into replay.
primary_comparisons: Within each seed/checkpoint/map, exploration-on minus exploration-off frozen GOOD+ and mean utility, with all three on streams shown.
Within each seed/checkpoint/exploration state, continuation-map minus common-panel frozen GOOD+ and mean utility.
logged_metrics: Every probe judgement, hit error, utility and predictor residual
Every DOWN action disposition and relative time, exploration pulse count/times, motor population spike count
Frozen weight equality, checkpoint time and weight summary, per-seed and cohort paired differences
limits: Diagnostic selected seeds and one common panel; not a new learning or generalization gate. Exploration-on branches retain frozen weights, so they test performance support from exploratory motor pulses rather than further learning. No model settings are selected from probe outcomes.
